svg.title: Architecture today
svg.desc: The Worker is live and answering, and the domain still is not pointed at it. crystalina.org is served by GitHub Pages from the repository root; the Worker at crystalina.crystalina.workers.dev serves dist and runs the three API routes. One address has the server code and no visitors; the other has the visitors and no server. Verified 2026-11-02.
